5f369eeac01a188bc7dc06d0 description: Well, you've been with me for a while in these operations, so let's do the following. I can guarantee that you won't be targeted by my people during raids, but let's practice your role within the "ISB". Deal?
5f369eeac01a188bc7dc06d0 successMessageT: You did well. Let's move on.
935421a346e854a6d2337c37 description: Currently, my network relies on the highly useful participation of Mechanic and Jaeger. I need to make sure you don't disappoint them either; after all, you want my trust? You need to have theirs too.
935421a346e854a6d2337c37 successMessageT: Mechanic and Jaeger trust you. That's enough for the next stage.
f999ba37e8dda410954c0c1f description: Let's see if you can handle placing yourself in the crosshairs of an impeccable aim. By now, you must know Lightkeeper. He frequently annoys me, so how about we send him a delicate warning? Take out one of his trusted sniper's guards, but do not hurt him or any other guards. This is just a warning.
f999ba37e8dda410954c0c1f successMessageT: A single guard. The warning has been delivered.
f999ba37e8dda410954c0c1f failMessageText: You crossed the imposed limit. I do not tolerate failure.
5b31aa2fac1326ea27852fb6: Neutralize one of Zryachiy's guards on Lighthouse without neutralizing Zryachiy or another guard
4660ba9168903321ed40bfee description: During firefights, it's very difficult to tell friend from foe, and I want to see if you are up for it. My people frequently conduct operations on Lighthouse and in The Lab. Do a few raids in those locations without hurting any ISB operatives.
4660ba9168903321ed40bfee successMessageT: Eight raids and zero ISB casualties. You've shown the discipline I needed.
4660ba9168903321ed40bfee failMessageText: You crossed the imposed limit. I do not tolerate failure.

ba02d1c72f3ca4c5d6625bf2 description: You did your part. This radio can be used to broadcast your presence in the area. My people will not consider you hostile while you are using it.
